children: Beyond Meat was ordered to pay $15,437,500 after a court reduced jury actual damages to $37,500 but upheld $15.4M disgorgement.
Jury found Beyond Meat liable for trademark infringement and awarded $23.5M actual damages and $15.4M disgorgement in Nov 2025.
On Sept 18, 2026, court reduced actual damages to $37,500, left $15.4M disgorgement intact, entering $15,437,500 judgment.
Court denied plaintiff’s requests for prejudgment interest and increased disgorgement; parties may pursue further motions or appeals.
The suit alleged Beyond Meat’s taglines caused trademark infringement and sought injunctive relief, corrective advertising, royalties and damages.
